One of them, Mior, can also modify a VM's memory and fake the signed report confirming which software it runs. items.description: A simple typing mistake can now cost you more than a failed page load. items.description: Hackers are hiding cryptocurrency mining on Linux GPU servers by changing the readings administrators use to spot heavy workloads. The toolkit combines a Rust-based controller called SANSAR, a kernel rootkit, and a modified NVIDIA monitoring library that reports 0% GPU utilization while mining continues in the background. items.description: Three Trezor Safe 5 wallets bought from the reseller CryptoBilis contain an implant, an extra circuit board that can copy their recovery phrases, hardware wallet maker Trezor said yesterday.
